title: Pin Payment Handler to Payment Nodes
description:
**SITUATION:**

Payment traffic must stay on a reserved pool of machines (PCI reviews, dedicated NICs). Today Payment Handler can land on any node — including general Order Processor nodes. Platform labeled the payment pool; you need to tell Kubernetes: **only schedule Payment Handler there**.

This lab **pins Payment Handler** onto payment-labeled nodes with a hard rule (nodeSelector / required affinity). Soft preferences come next; here “anywhere else” is not acceptable.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. **Update** the Payment Handler Deployment so Pods use a **nodeSelector**.
2. Verify Pods are **Ready** and running only on nodes with that label.

**SPEC:**

- Deployment name: `payment-handler` (do not rename)
- Replicas: keep **`2`**
- `nodeSelector`: `workload: payments`
- Keep existing container image, labels, and port
- Ready: **2/2** Pods Ready on matching nodes

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifest: `payment-handler-nodeselector-l25.yaml`.
- Do **not** use nodeAffinity / taints for this lab — plain `nodeSelector` only.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

hints: Your namespace is in the lab chrome and in $LEARNER_NS — kubectl already defaults there.
Work only in your lab namespace (not default).
Read SPEC carefully, apply your YAML, then Submit.

problemStatement.brief: Pin Payment Handler to Payment Nodes
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Pin Payment Handler to Payment Nodes

Update Deployment `payment-handler` with a hard `nodeSelector` so replicas only land on nodes labeled `workload=payments`.

Docs: [Assigning Pods to Nodes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/)

## Solution YAML

Save as `payment-handler-nodeselector-l25.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payment-handler
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-handler
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payment-handler
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: payments
      containers:
        - name: payment-handler
          image: rithvikreddyalkanti/payment-handler:v1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f payment-handler-nodeselector-l25.yaml
kubectl get deploy payment-handler -o wide
kubectl get pods -l app=payment-handler -o wide
```

Wait until **2/2** Pods are Ready on payment-labeled nodes, then **Submit**. Use `nodeSelector` only (no affinity/taints).
